caption:
Watch the crossing point run away.

Add a slider for k and drag it. When the intersection flies off screen and the lines go parallel, you've found the no-solution value.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: No solution? Slide k in Desmos until the lines go parallel.
